Loss report: gha -> drone
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/flaky job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/flaky/step/flaky-step-1 step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/flaky job.allow_failure: failure ignore on every step (later steps still run after a failed step)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/flaky job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
